scope: Google Docs rich version preview, naming, restore, and copy synchronized with Drive
changes: Capture complete document structures including tabs, formatting, tables and inline objects on native Docs edits and Drive updates
Preview any tab without mutating current editor state; name versions and filter named versions; enforce 40 named versions
Restore as a new revision while retaining current metadata and prior versions; copy a selected rich version into a new document
Require edit permission and write scopes even for history reads; stale revisions and invalid mutations rejected
Persist history only in run-scoped shared state and clear it on reset/permanent file deletion

checks: Preview version 2 retaining bold release text, table and two document tabs
Save named version and restore it with in-page confirmation
Reload at 390px, filter named versions and switch historical tab previews
Copy version 2 into Mobile approved copy; reload retains content and table
Document width and scroll width both 390
browser.protected_state: Complete stored rich document state equals selected version except new revision number; copied state also matches; protected document unchanged
browser.initial_attempt: Native confirm dialog stalled while Mac was locked; replaced with accessible in-page confirmation, rerun passed

limits: Historical edits before rich snapshots were introduced cannot reconstruct lost rich content
Detailed author-colored text differences, grouped version expansion, history deletion, and copy destination/sharing selectors remain open
No full Docs feature or exhaustive visual/mobile parity claim
review_followup: Reject malformed/non-object bodies atomically through shared Drive validation
Clear stale selected version and disable restore/copy/name while preview loads; ignore stale response errors
